correctness.rationale: Independently generated every one of the 9,841 normalized nonzero F3 bidegree-(2,2) forms, the complete PGL2(F3)^2 semidirect-swap group (1,152 elements), and its 41 disjoint projective orbits. An independent polynomial discriminant-squarefreeness algorithm yields exactly 14 smooth orbits/5,184 equations and the complete 12-stratum N/branch-pair/deck-period table matching data/orbits.json. Exactly representative 1020 has order 7, with orbit size 576. The original package also supplies independent four-chart Groebner tests. The genus-one involutions compose to rational translation by the nonzero difference of the degree-two ruling line bundles: since every listed curve has an F3 point, permutation period equals geometric translation order. Hasse bounds #E(F3)<=7. Enumeration is genuinely exhaustive for F3, not a sampling argument for a larger field.
